runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Persisted sessions in disposable HOME and CODEX_HOME directories; generated Skill under project .agents/skills; user configuration and project rules ignored; root fixed to gpt-6-astra with medium reasoning; one worker requested as gpt-5.6-luna with low reasoning directly at spawn.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: The parent read the generated check-model-routing Skill before executing it.
The parent made exactly one spawn_agent call and the isolated state directory contains exactly one child thread.
The spawn call requested gpt-5.6-luna while the parent turn_context recorded gpt-6-astra.
The spawn call requested low reasoning while the parent turn_context recorded medium.
The parent collected the terminal result from /root/routing_worker.
The persisted child turn_context independently recorded model=gpt-5.6-luna.
The persisted child turn_context independently recorded effort=low.
The child transcript attributes the worker asset read and ROUTING_MARKER=model-routing-ok result to /root/routing_worker.
Parent command events did not read worker.txt; references were limited to instructions and an exclusion glob.
The parent read assets/root.txt before and after delegation and observed ROOT_MARKER=model-routing-root-ok.
External Git status with untracked probe logs excluded reported no tracked changes.

limitations: This evidence applies to Codex CLI 0.155.1 with persisted sessions, not ephemeral mode, desktop, or IDE surfaces.
The model identifiers are target-specific probe inputs and evidence, not portable-core policy.
Unrelated installed MCP providers attempted startup in the disposable state directory and emitted authentication warnings; the model-routing probe used no MCP provider and completed successfully.
